description: Return UI-ready cards and an interactive MCP Apps gallery for 1–10 FlatHunt listing ids. The tool refreshes current listing data and displays images, provider, price, availability and listing actions. Optional alertCriteria adds a saved-search control for the represented filters.

alertCriteria.description: Optional saved-search criteria represented by this result set. Every nested field is optional. Pagination and sort fields are not accepted.

amenityTags.description: Optional. Canonical amenity tags (AND) from the search, e.g. wifi, parking, washing_machine.

anmeldungLikely.description: Optional. Anmeldung-likely filter from the search.

areas.description: Optional. Canonical area ids from list_areas used in the search.

availableFrom.description: Optional. Available-from date (YYYY-MM-DD) from the search.

availableTo.description: Optional. Available-to date (YYYY-MM-DD) from the search.

bedroomsMin.description: Optional. Minimum bedrooms from the search.

depositMax.description: Optional. Maximum deposit EUR from the search.

housingType.description: Optional. Same housingType as the preceding search_listings call.

name.description: Optional. Short saved-search label in the user's language so Save search uses a meaningful name (not a generic default).

noSchufaLikely.description: Optional. No-Schufa-likely filter from the search.

noSchufaRequired.description: Optional. No-Schufa-required filter from the search.

onlyStudentsAllowed.description: Optional. Students-only filter from the search.

personsMaxMin.description: Optional. Minimum capacity from the search.

petsAllowed.description: Optional. Pets filter from the search.

postCode.description: Optional. Exact Berlin PLZ from the search.

priceMax.description: Optional. Maximum monthly price in EUR from the search.

priceMin.description: Optional. Minimum monthly price in EUR from the search.

providers.description: Optional. Provider ids from the search.

registrationPossible.description: Optional. Anmeldung/registration filter from the search.

roomType.description: Optional. Same roomType as the preceding search_listings call.

rooms.description: Optional. Exact room counts from the search. Allowed: "studio", "1"…"10" (strings only).

roomsMax.description: Optional. Maximum rooms from the search.

roomsMin.description: Optional. Minimum rooms from the search (studio = 0).

schufaRequired.description: Optional. Schufa-required filter from the search.

smokingAllowed.description: Optional. Smoking filter from the search.

squareMetersMax.description: Optional. Maximum living area m² from the search.

squareMetersMin.description: Optional. Minimum living area m² from the search.

studentsFriendly.description: Optional. Students-friendly filter from the search.

listingIds.description: Between 1 and 10 unique FlatHunt listing ids.
